reviewThreads.resolution: Both original commits were fetched into a brand-new empty repository from existing public refs. Retention tags now pin them, and CI fetches and checks both objects explicitly.
A nonzero evaluator status returns before any preview or live pending apply, in both dry-run and normal modes.
Atomically commit a shared database-time execution budget before the executor. Restarted and concurrent agents cannot reset it; uncertain attempts consume capacity.
Checkout the exact triggering head and restrict verification receipts to candidates matching the actual checked Git HEAD. Other candidates retain only separate discovery evidence.

limitations: The added agent-budget migration was applied only inside the private test cluster; no hosted schema was mutated.
Source retention tags point to already-public objects. They are not release or deployment tags.
The exact pinned OpenTofu action was added to selected-actions after its startup rejection. Broader GitHub Actions permissions remain unchanged.
Latest-head CI and review are required before serialized protected promotion.
